name: Two-Stage First and Second Referent Choice
summary: Listeners choose both their first-choice referent and a second-choice referent on each screen.

charter.question: Does eliciting both a primary choice and a follow-up choice on the same scene reveal graded pragmatic competition among candidate referents?

instructions.welcome: Welcome! In this study you will look at groups of friendly robots and figure out which robot a speaker is talking about.
instructions.task: On each screen you will see several robots and answer two questions about which robot the speaker means.

comprehension_checks.question: What is your task on each screen?
options: Click the robot you think the speaker means for each question.
Type a name for each robot.
Click only robots with no parts.
